mapper.select: SELECT m.memberNo AS memberNo, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(c.checkDate)) AS recencyDays, COUNT(c.checkNo) AS frequency, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.rechargeMoney), 0) FROM recharge r WHERE r.memberNo = m.memberNo AND r.rechargeStatus = 1 AND r.rechargeDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) AS monetary FROM member m LEFT JOIN checkin c ON c.memberNo = m.memberNo AND c.checkDate >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY m.memberNo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_segment (member_no, recency_days, frequency, monetary, segment, score, computed_at) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{recencyDays}, #{frequency}, #{monetary}, #{segment}, #{score}, #{computedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recency_days = VALUES(recency_days), frequency = VALUES(frequency), monetary = VALUES(monetary), segment = VALUES(segment), score = VALUES(score), computed_at = VALUES(computed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT s.member_no AS memberNo, s.segment AS segment, s.score AS score, s.recency_days AS recencyDays, s.frequency AS frequency, s.monetary AS monetary, s.computed_at AS computedAt, m.memberName AS memberName, m.memberPhone AS memberPhone FROM member_segment s LEFT JOIN member m ON m.memberNo = s.member_no WHERE (#{segment} IS NULL OR s.segment = #{segment}) ORDER BY s.score DESC LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_churn_signal (member_no, signal_type, weight, detail, detected_at) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{signalType}, #{weight}, #{detail}, #{detectedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT member_no AS memberNo, COUNT(*) AS signalCount, ROUND(SUM(weight), 2) AS riskScore FROM member_churn_signal GROUP BY member_no ORDER BY riskScore DESC, signalCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_daily_snapshot (snapshot_date, new_members, checkin_count, recharge_amount, course_seat_rate, created_at) VALUES (#{snapshotDate}, #{newMembers}, #{checkinCount}, #{rechargeAmount}, #{courseSeatRate}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE new_members = VALUES(new_members), checkin_count = VALUES(checkin_count), recharge_amount = VALUES(recharge_amount), course_seat_rate = VALUES(course_seat_rate), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, snapshot_date AS snapshotDate, new_members AS newMembers, checkin_count AS checkinCount, recharge_amount AS rechargeAmount, course_seat_rate AS courseSeatRate, created_at AS createdAt FROM ops_daily_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY snapshot_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_maintenance (equipment_no, plan_type, title, status, assignee, cost, planned_date, created_at) VALUES (#{equipmentNo}, #{planType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{assignee}, #{cost}, #{plannedDate}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_maintenance SET status = #{to}, assignee = IFNULL(#{assignee}, assignee), cost = IFNULL(#{cost}, cost), finished_at = IFNULL(#{finishedAt}, finished_at) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.equipment_no AS equipmentNo, e.equipmentName, o.plan_type AS planType, o.title, o.status, o.assignee, o.cost, o.planned_date AS plannedDate, o.finished_at AS finishedAt, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM equipment_maintenance o LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.equipmentNo = o.equipment_no WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR o.status = #{status}) ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_maintenance_log (order_id, action, operator, note, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{action}, #{operator}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, action, operator, note, created_at AS createdAt FROM equipment_maintenance_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at, id
